## Constraints & Preferences

## Key Decisions
- Changed all pure black `#000000` / `Colors.background` to `#0A0A0F` (dark but visible) across home, login, providers, and tabs layout — prevents black screen from being indistinguishable from a crash
- Added 8-second `homeLoadTimeout` on home screen — if JV deals still loading after 8s, shows ActivityIndicator + retry message instead of silent black screen
- Added `gradientUnderlay` View behind home content as visual safety net
- Built Expo app natively via Gradle (`./gradlew :app:assembleRelease`) instead of relying on Expo Go runtime
- Generated Expo release keystore (`ivx-release.keystore`, PKCS12, password `ivxholdings`) for native APK signing
- Used WebSocket instead of WebRTC for real-time voice — WebRTC requires custom native module not compatible with Expo Go
- Realtime voice uses push-to-talk (not automatic VAD)
- Progressive TTS: AI text split into sentences as they stream, each synthesized independently
- Expo `_layout.tsx` uses ultra-minimal module surface with deferred `_providers.tsx` import to prevent permanent black screen on provider crash
- Expo `(tabs)/_layout.tsx` wraps tabs in `DiagnosticErrorBoundary` for route-level crash isolation
- Disabled Material You dynamic color in Kotlin Theme.kt (Kotlin app only, not relevant to Expo fix)
